notes: Identity independently assessed from the supplied canonical text: title Racial Diversity Matters: The Impact of Diversity-Related Student Engagement and Institutional Context; authors Nida Denson and Mitchell J. Chang; American Educational Research Journal, June 2009, Vol. 46, No. 2, pp. 322-353; DOI 10.3102/0002831208323278. These agree with the neutral original reference. The file is a primary published article text with methods, results, tables, appendices, notes and references, rather than an abstract, secondary article or preregistration. No PDF was supplied; no rendering or acquisition performed. The sole locator p. 15, interpreted as article page 15 (printed p.336), contains multiple outcomes, predictors and tests and does not select one. Printed journal p.15 is outside this article. The neutral reference identifies the article but not the target effect. Row order and numeric matching were not used. Candidate evidence, NOT assigned to any audit row: final HLM results (pp. 335-339, Table 3) include self-efficacy curricular-diversity base coefficient .08, t=4.01, p<.001; self-efficacy CRI base .14, t=7.39, p<.001; general-academic-skills curricular-diversity base .17, t=10.40, p<.001; general-academic-skills CRI base .16, t=9.74, p<.001; general-academic-skills institutional average curricular-diversity .31, t=3.84, p<.001; racial-cultural-engagement curricular-diversity base .22, t=18.57, p<.001; racial-cultural-engagement CRI base .35, t=32.28, p<.001; racial-cultural-engagement institutional average curricular-diversity .24, t=4.09, p<.001; racial-cultural-engagement institutional average CRI .32, t=5.47, p<.001. These p bounds come from the same Table 3 tests marked *** and its p<.001 legend; coefficients retain narrative printed precision. The random CRI slope for general academic skills is separately printed as variance τ22=.01, χ2=274.27, p<.05 (p.336). Table 3 additionally contains control coefficients and cross-level interactions; Table 2 has unconditional models and Tables 4-5 percentage-of-variance-explained values. The opaque requested label ser_method does not identify one coefficient, standardisation or test; no conversion attempted. Sample candidates only (p.329): 20,178 students nested within 236 institutions is the final total before outcome-specific pairwise deletion; analytic student counts range 19,794 to 19,978, without an outcome-specific mapping in the inspected methods/results. Neither the total nor either endpoint is assigned as analytic N. Institutions are clusters, not interchangeable with student observations. Note 1 (p.350) lists exclusions: missing/other race 506; missing/other planned residence 52; 2-year institutions 12; historically Black colleges/universities 313; institutions with fewer than 15 respondents 168; missing enrollment/selectivity 422; remaining missing variables replaced by respondent-race means. No N inferred from df, no sum performed, and no common-model N promoted to a matched row. Only the three assigned original unfinished fields were assessed. Unassigned side and reported_success are placeholders.
